hero_title: Get emergency help to the right place,
hero_subtitle: Report any emergency in seconds. SafeNet instantly notifies the nearest available hospital, police or rescue team — automatically.
trusted_by: Trusted by citizens, hospitals, police & fire brigades
how_subtitle: Four steps from report to response — handled automatically
step1_desc: Describe the emergency and share your location. Takes about 30 seconds.
step2_desc: SafeNet automatically finds the nearest available hospital, police or fire station.
step3_desc: Resource managers receive instant notifications by SMS, email and in the app.
step4_desc: Follow your report live as it goes from Waiting → Help coming → Resolved.

perk_r2: Accept or reject with one tap

stories_subtitle: Stories from communities SafeNet serves across Kigali.
testimonial1_quote: I reported a road accident and within minutes the nearest clinic was already notified. The responder arrived in under 8 minutes. This platform genuinely saves lives.
testimonial2_quote: Before SafeNet, incident reports came by radio — easy to miss. Now I get an instant alert with the exact location. We handled 23 incidents last month through this platform.
testimonial3_quote: We update our availability and the system routes emergencies to us automatically. Three of our emergency patients last month came directly through SafeNet alerts.
cta_title: Your community deserves faster emergency response.
cta_subtitle: Free for citizens. Built for the people who protect communities.
